description: Role-aware V1 grammar for scripts/ zone. Extends the one-shape template with three role families.

runnable_entrypoint.description: Has __main__ guard; designed to be executed directly from the command line.

required.name: has_main_guard
required.description: if __name__ == '__main__' entry point so the script is runnable

optional.name: has_shebang
optional.description: #!/usr/bin/env python3 as the very first line

optional.name: has_argparse
optional.description: argparse.ArgumentParser for structured CLI argument handling

import_safe_support.description: Importable library code: no __main__ guard, no top-level side effects on import, has functions or classes.

optional.name: has_future_annotations
optional.description: from __future__ import annotations at the top of imports

excluded.name: no_main_guard
excluded.description: Must NOT have an __main__ guard (that would be runnable_entrypoint)

excluded.name: no_import_side_effect
excluded.description: Must NOT have top-level side effects (sys.path mutations, bare calls)

constraints.description: Must define at least one function or class (otherwise: declaration_module)

declaration_module.description: Primarily constants, tables, or schema-like data. No behavior functions. No __main__ guard.

optional.name: has_future_annotations
optional.description: from __future__ import annotations at the top of imports

excluded.name: no_import_side_effect
excluded.description: Must NOT have top-level side effects

unclassified.description: Does not cleanly fit any role family. Review manually. NOT a catch-all success bucket — only files with genuine ambiguity or import side effects land here.
trigger_conditions: No __main__ guard AND has top-level side effects (sys.path mutation or bare function call)

boundaries.name: main_guard
boundaries.description: Primary boundary. Separates runnable_entrypoint from all importable families.

boundaries.name: import_safety
boundaries.description: Non-trivial boundary. A file that modifies sys.path or executes bare calls at module top level is not safely importable; it cannot be import_safe_support or declaration_module.

boundaries.name: behavior_vs_data
boundaries.description: Separates import_safe_support (has behavior) from declaration_module (data only).
